friendly_name: Multilingual Meeting Transcription (Quick Switcher & Offline Model Setup)
purpose_context: This mission delivers GitHub Issue #148 by adding a Menu Bar quick language switcher for meetings, model availability indicators with 1-click Dictation deep linking in Settings > Audio, and 'Transcribe Last Recording Again As...' language picker, while preserving 0% idle CPU and zero polling.
purpose_tldr: Provide zero-friction Menu Bar language switching, offline Dictation model status & setup deep link in Settings, and choose-language re-transcription
